caption: 💌 SAVE this for your next tough morning! ✨ FOLLOW for more episodes of our Sweet Potato Snacks series ... easy, wholesome, toddler-approved treats from scratch. Episode  Soft, fiber rich sweet potato brownies 🍠✨ Ingredients: ½ cup (150g )sweet potato, cooked & mashed ½ cup (100g) pitted Agen prunes & soaked  ½ cup (60g) spelt flour 2 tbsp cocoa powder  2 tbsp olive oil 1 egg Instructions: 1. Blend sweet potato and prunes until smooth. 2. Add egg, olive oil, flour, and cocoa, and mix until combined. 3. Pour into an 18×12 cm pan and bake at 180°C for 22 min. 4. Let cool slightly, then cut into toddler-friendly bars. Perfect for breakfast or snack time 👌 naturally sweet, fiber rich, melt in the mouth, and designed to turn chaotic mornings into settled moments 💛✨ No refined sugar, all joy, gentle on little tummies.
